objective: Stored execution priority is re-read as planner necessity, demoting mandatory fragments. server/services/research/quota.ts ~L127 assignExecutionPriority overwrites brief.priority (planner necessity 1/5/8) with a tier rank (1-7), and tierOf ~L109 reads fragment.priority as necessity for stored fragments in executionOrder (orchestrator.ts ~L1105, review.ts ~L210). After assignment a necessity-1 brief holds priority 5 and re-derives as SUPPORTING_CONTEXT. Fix: add storedTier(fragment) reading PRIORITY_TIERS by stored rank with the structural overrides still applied; use it in executionOrder and export it for review.ts; keep tierOf's necessity branch for planner briefs only; assignExecutionPriority must be idempotent.
expectedOutcome: A mandatory fragment stays mandatory after its priority is stored, and assignment is idempotent.

Existing research suites pass and the repository typechecks.
